findings.summary: 4 change-entry.md `## Ciclo` table cells had short SHAs (1-39 chars) in `Base SHA` rows; CCs #22/#23 silently skipped them due to `len(head) != 40` precondition
findings.lens_summary: Detection: regex sweep of SHA-keyed table cells across all change-entry.md `## Ciclo` tables. Cause: CCs #22/#23 use `len(head) != 40` as precondition, skipping short SHAs. Fix: expand each short SHA to full 40-char via `git rev-parse`; add cross-check #49 that explicitly detects short SHAs in SHA-keyed metadata cells (independent of canonical-format precondition).

lens_summary: m9-58 closes the short-SHA-in-SHA-metadata drift class. 4 change-entry `## Ciclo` table cells had short Base SHA values missed by CCs #22/#23. CC#49 added to detect this drift class going forward. CC#48 meta-check confirms all 49 CCs now report 0 DRIFT lines.
